people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: All the princes of the provinces, the local governors, the governors, and those who did the king’s business helped the Jews, because the fear of Mordecai had fallen on them.
translations.bsb: And all the officials of the provinces, the satraps, the governors, and the king’s administrators helped the Jews, because the fear of Mordecai had fallen upon them.
